title: Abel-Jacobi Map and Symplectic Topology
summary: We develop a harmonic-coordinate approach to the identity component $G_ω(Σ_g)$ of the symplectomorphism group of a closed oriented surface of genus $g\ge2$. Using an intrinsic decomposition of the Abel-Jacobi displacement into a global flux part and a zero-average harmonic fluctuation, we introduce the harmonic flux norm and prove its non-degeneracy on the full identity component without Floer theory.
